We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (ID 1914386) to the molecule given (initial_molecule). The previous step gave mapped_rxn and template_id. We need to apply the template to the target molecule (the initial_molecule) to get precursors.

We have tool apply_template which takes molecule_smiles and template_id. Use that.

We have template_id as integer 1914386 but tool expects string like "template_123". Not sure format. The get_template expects "template_123". But apply_template expects template_id string. The ID may be "1914386". Might need to pass as string "1914386". Let's try.
